settings.label: Send visitors to
settings.info: Your EmDash site's domain, without http:// or https://.

settings.label: Paths on your site
settings.info: One rule per line: store path > site path. :name matches one part of the path, * at the end matches the rest. The first match wins, and other paths stay the same. [Learn more](https://github.com/webmultipliers/redeemid-emdash-shopify-redirect-theme#paths-on-your-site)

settings.label: Carry sign-in over to the site
settings.info: Adds logged_in=true when the customer is signed in to the store, so the site signs them in too without a form. [Learn more](https://github.com/webmultipliers/redeemid-emdash-shopify-redirect-theme#sign-in)
